basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 2.' and it opens 'Vers. 2. Misit Abimelech, et tulit eam. Quaeri potest in illa jam aetate quomodo amari'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 2. Misit Abimelech, et tulit eam. Quaeri potest in illa jam aetate quomodo amari poterat Sara, cum esset anus decrepita? Sed hoc mirandum potius, quam quaerendum, quod tantus decor formae in ea fuerit ut nec senectus ejusdem pulchritudinem potuerit derogare.
